description:
Read the DEPLOYED copy of a connector — the files ADAS Core is actually running. This is a runtime projection of the last successful deploy, NOT the source of record: it can differ from the authored source, and it may exist for a connector the Builder cannot reproduce at all. Answers carry authored_source_of_record:false so that is never in doubt.

Use it to diagnose ("what is actually running?"), to compare against ateam_get_connector_source, or to inspect a connector whose authored source is missing before deciding whether to adopt it with ateam_recover_connector_source. Do NOT copy bytes out of here and re-upload them as if you had authored them — that launders a runtime copy into the source of record and hides the fact that the real source was lost.

path.description: Optional. Read ONE file. Omit for a manifest (paths + sizes) — a whole connector exceeds the output limit and truncates.

name: ateam_get_deployed_connector_source
